caption: 60 meters under the current rules: a contiguous 5351.5–5366.5 kHz segment you may use anywhere inside at 9.15 W ERP, plus four discrete channels centered on 5332, 5348, 5373, and 5405 kHz at 100 W ERP each; emissions are USB phone, CW, RTTY, and data, never wider than 2.8 kHz anywhere on the band. The old 5358.5 kHz channel is gone as a discrete assignment — it lies inside the new segment.
spoken: a frequency axis from 5300 to 5420 kHz showing the contiguous 5351.5 to 5366.5 segment at 9.15 watts ERP and four narrow channels at 5332, 5348, 5373, and 5405 at 100 watts ERP
